say:2:1330376001:1.text: We were just debating if our savior could've turned into one of those undead. Now he wants to track down Igor at the ancient battlefield!
say:2:1330376001:1.source_cn: 我们刚才聊到恩人有没有可能变成活死人。他非要去古战场找...
say:2:1330376001:1.male: We were just debating if our savior could've turned into one of those undead. Now he wants to track down Igor at the ancient battlefield!
say:2:1330376001:1.female: We were just debating if our savior could've turned into one of those undead. Now he wants to track down Igor at the ancient battlefield!

say:3:1330376002:1.text: Look, the undead don't just appear out of thin air. They were warriors, people from Whiteridge. I'm more and more convinced I can find my savior among them!
say:3:1330376002:1.source_cn: 活死人不是凭空冒出来的，是从前的战士，是白山的人们，我...
say:3:1330376002:1.male: Look, the undead don't just appear out of thin air. They were warriors, people from Whiteridge. I'm more and more convinced I can find my savior among them!
say:3:1330376002:1.female: Look, the undead don't just appear out of thin air. They were warriors, people from Whiteridge. I'm more and more convinced I can find my savior among them!

say:4:1330376003:1.text: Vyka, calm down! Our savior wasn't from that era at all.
say:4:1330376003:1.source_cn: 弗拉，冷静！恩人不是那个时代的！
